name: karabo-device-development
description: Guidance for implementing, reviewing, debugging, and testing Karabo devices and synchronous macros across the C++, bound-Python, and middlelayer APIs, including behavior-driven pytest and coverage analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Build and test Karabo devices and synchronous macros.
interface.longDescription: Routes Karabo device and macro work to detailed guidance for classic C++, bound-Python, asynchronous middlelayer devices, and synchronous macros. Includes workflows for targeted pytest tests, regression tests accompanying implementation, failure diagnosis, fixtures, and behavior-driven coverage improvement.
interface.defaultPrompt: Implement, review, or test this Karabo device or synchronous macro using the correct API and pytest guidance.
